-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.MemstorageApi` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def memStorInv (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) : IProp GF :=
  memStorInvP ms γs (memStorJ γ K)

theorem memStorJ_B_lb [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (k :
    Nat) : (memStorJ γ K).B k ⊢ nodeAppliedLb γ K k

def memStorJ (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) : MemJust GF :=
  { SV := snapshotValid γ, B := fun k => iprop(nodeAppliedLb γ K k ∗ ⌜clusterNoSnap γ → k ≤ 1⌝), DL := nodeCommitLb γ K,
    SV_pers := ⋯, B_pers := ⋯, B_timeless := ⋯, DL_pers := ⋯ }

theorem memStorJ_B_off [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (k :
    Nat) (h : ¬clusterNoSnap γ) : nodeAppliedLb γ K k ⊢ (memStorJ γ K).B k

theorem memStorage_isStorage [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (wp_LastIndex :
    MemoryStorage.LastIndex.spec) (wp_FirstIndex : MemoryStorage.FirstIndex.spec) (wp_Term :
    MemoryStorage.Term.spec) (wp_Entries : MemoryStorage.Entries.spec) (wp_Snapshot :
    MemoryStorage.Snapshot.spec) (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (hsz :
    γ.maxData.isSome = true → γs.sz = true) (htr : γ.trace = none) : ⊢ memStorInv ms γs γ K -∗
    memStorReg ms γs -∗ isStorage γ K (memStorIface ms)

theorem memStorInv_persistent (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) : Persistent
    (memStorInv ms γs γ K)

theorem memStorInv_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames)
    (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (c : Nat) (sv : SnapshotM) (E : CoPset) (Hcap : clusterNoSnap γ → c ≤
    1) : ⊢ memStorLock ms γs -∗ memStorFresh ms γs c sv -∗ nodeAppliedLb γ K c -∗
    ⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = W64 0⌝ ∨ snapshotValid γ sv ∗ nodeCommitLb γ K (uint.nat
    sv.Metadata'.Index') ={E}=∗ memStorInv ms γs γ K

theorem memStorJ_B_le_one [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (k :
    Nat) (h : k ≤ 1) : nodeAppliedLb γ K k ⊢ (memStorJ γ K).B k
